document.about: Panasonic FP series digest catalogue. Its specification tables rule model columns apart only where the models differ, and leave some columns unruled under a shaded header.

notes: A column rule drawn in a few rows fell short of a grid line, so two models read as one column.
A table whose middle column is unruled touches in two sets of rules; only its header band joins them.
A row label read across the sub-columns of the rows above it, where their rule stops short of it, was cut at that rule and its pieces joined with a space (`Rea l-time clock function`).
2026-11-24 (#112): a header shaded down to its first row with no rule between them was read as one row with it.

checks.issue: #103: C10 and C14 read `10 points 14 points` in one cell.
#102: the FP2SH table's header and first row were loose paragraphs.
#104: `Self -diagnostic function`, `Rea l-time clock function`: the label was cut where a sub-column rule of the rows above it would run.
#112: `Product No. FPG-PP11`, `Part No. AFPG430` were the header; the first product was no row.
